continuity.masterLook: Create a 16:9 cinematic keyframe for a restrained executive strategy film. The recurring protagonist is exactly one adult male professional of medium build, shown from the rear or three-quarter rear so he is not an identifiable real person. Preserve the same short dark hair, navy technical work jacket, slate trousers, and black boots. The world is a monumental engineered blue-black incline leading to a clean geometric summit, with cool cyan-white guide lights, realistic graphite, glass, and anodised-metal materials, generous negative space, and quiet premium enterprise-documentary lighting. Transactional work is always a matte graphite-grey cuboid with no connector or internal light. Entitled Drawdown is violet, Committed Capacity is cyan-blue, and Standing Services is aqua. Keep scale, geometry, palette, wardrobe, and lighting consistent. No readable text, logos, captions, extra people, duplicate protagonist, unsafe lifting, fantasy architecture, toy-like styling, warm sunset light, or unexplained objects.
continuity.seedanceGuardrails: Generate one continuous 8-second 16:9 720p shot in Omni mode with native audio enabled. Put the most important reference first. Explicitly bind each required subject, material, composition, or motion to its @image or @video reference. Execute one clear physical action and one controlled camera move. Complete the meaningful action by 6.0 seconds, then settle into a stable hold through 8.0 seconds for edit handles. Preserve the protagonist, wardrobe, block geometry, real weight, contact shadows, safe handling, colour palette, and spatial continuity. No cuts, montage, speed ramps, camera shake, dialogue, lip movement, readable text, subtitles, logos, duplicated subjects, extra blocks, geometry warping, floating objects, sudden lighting changes, or style drift. AUDIO CONTRACT: generate a clean, synchronised diegetic sound-effects stem only. Use realistic footsteps, clothing movement, block contact, mechanical locks, and restrained environmental ambience only when physically visible or specified for this shot. No music, melody, harmony, rhythm bed, percussion, bass, tonal drone, cinematic riser, narration, speech, dialogue, singing, humming, grunts, breaths, crowd, radio, or logo sting. Keep the effects natural, restrained, and easy to mix beneath externally produced ElevenLabs narration and Suno score. Labels, exact counts, captions, and approved brand artwork are added in post.
continuity.referenceSyntax: Pixio maps images_list in array order to @image1, @image2, and onward; videos_list maps to @video1, @video2, and onward; audio_list maps to @audio1, @audio2, and onward. The prompt must say what property to take from each reference rather than simply listing assets.
continuity.rerollRule: For a controlled alternate, change only the seed first. Change prompt wording only after recording the specific failure. Never change prompt, reference order, and seed simultaneously.

audio.seedanceSfxPolicy: Generate native synchronised sound effects only. The Seedance audio must be a clean diegetic foley stem: physically justified footsteps, fabric movement, block handling, surface contact, mechanical engagement, and restrained environmental ambience. Generate no music, melody, harmony, percussion, bass, tonal drone, cinematic riser, narration, voiceover, speech, dialogue, singing, humming, grunts, breaths, crowd, radio, or logo sting. Do not use an audio reference unless a deliberately approved foley reference is required; keep audio_list empty for the planned first pass. Leave the mix spacious so externally produced ElevenLabs narration and Suno instrumental can sit above it.
audio.stemWorkflow:
THREE-STEM MASTER
1. SEEDANCE SFX — Generate with generate_audio true and audio_list empty. Immediately demux the chosen clip audio to a 48 kHz WAV and preserve its generation ID and seed. Trim the picture and its synchronised foley together; use short equal-power fades at every edit.
2. ELEVENLABS VO — Keep as the intelligibility anchor in the centre. Never bake it into Seedance.
3. SUNO SCORE — Keep instrumental and continuous across the film. Never ask Seedance to imitate or continue it.
MIX STARTING POINT — Dialogue leads. Duck the score gently beneath narration; keep foley audible enough to make weight, contact, and locking actions credible without competing with consonants. Remove any Seedance clip whose audio contains music, speech, vocalisation, unexplained rhythm, or tonal contamination; do not try to hide it under the final mix. Deliver the final master plus separate VO, score, and SFX stems.

referenceTake.reason: The supplied take is preserved as the performance source. Long silences were reduced and the result was tempo-controlled to 58.35 seconds for the locked one-minute master.

audio.voiceoverReferenceTranscript:
Today, every AI engagement is carried uphill one transaction at a time.

We win the customer, deliver the work, and place another block at the top.

Then the contract ends, and we walk back down to win the next one.

New proposal. New mobilisation. The same climb, every time.

The work accumulates. The relationship does not. Faster delivery only repeats the cycle.

So we keep the catalogue and change the commitment around it.

Entitled Drawdown bundles the first next step into the sale.

Committed Capacity turns an isolated job into a pre-committed rhythm of work.

Standing Services keeps the customer estate operating after the build.

Across three years, transaction shrinks while drawdown, capacity, and standing become the load-bearing portfolio.

Enable. Capture. Establish. Build. Operate. Every offer names the next contract, and every customer commitment becomes the ground for the next.

audio.voiceoverTarget: 140-word supplied performance · mastered duration 58.35 seconds · begins with picture · leaves a clean final hold
audio.elevenLabsPrompt: Match the grounded, human, observant performance character of the supplied v3 reference take, but use the revised 102-word script. Australian executive voice, calm boardroom proximity rather than trailer narration. Keep pauses purposeful and compact. Give ‘The work accumulates; the relationship does not.’ one small sober pause without melodrama. Introduce Entitled Drawdown, Committed Capacity, and Standing Services with equal practical certainty. Let the delivery warm as the blocks begin to bind, then finish with spacious conviction rather than a call to action. Never breathless, heroic, ominous, theatrical, or salesy. Do not stretch the script to fill time; target a natural 58.0–59.0-second read.
audio.elevenLabsSettings: Existing personal voice; Eleven Multilingual v2; stability 0.55; similarity 0.82; style 0.10–0.15; speaker boost on; speed 1.00–1.02. Generate opening, middle, and close as separate takes if one-pass timing drifts.
audio.sunoPrompt: A restrained cinematic electronic instrumental for an executive strategy film: approximately 96 BPM, tactile graphite-and-metal pulse, cool spacious synths, and a subtle three-note climbing motif that repeatedly resets before interlocking into violet glass pulses, precise cyan modular rhythm, and a broad aqua foundation. Premium, intelligent, human, quietly optimistic; gradual build, no dramatic drop, ending in a calm sustained major-add-nine resolution.
audio.sunoExclude: Not entered in Basic/Simple mode. It has no separate Exclude Styles field. Use the Instrumental toggle and the positive description above; reject or reroll takes with vocals, trailer braams, epic drums, EDM drops, busy lead melody, or sentimental piano rather than pasting an Advanced-only exclusion list.
audio.sunoSelection: Graphite Ascend selected. Its opening 60 seconds provide the cleanest low-density start, controlled midpoint lift, and calm horizon-facing finish. The master uses short head and tail fades and keeps the score beneath narration.
